title: Characterize a conditional live projected-copy interface
body:
A projected copy `t=P c` permits an intervening vector shear `c+=A d` exactly when PA=0 at ERASE. This conditional replacement-interface lemma classifies the full update space; all 111 pinned PR589 rank-seven projectors have an eight-dimensional update space whose nonzero elements have rank one, while two distinct projected copies of the same center force A=0.

Scope is explicitly changed from scalar complete-value copies to rational vector states. It does not establish selected scalar/native or physical address admission. The fully stated toy rank invoice costs 16 versus baseline 14, so no gain is claimed.

Python 3.12 registered replay passes: 888 basis updates on 21,312 dirty columns, 111 wrong-line chronological failures and repairs, 6,105 exact kernel-intersection checks. Exact source pins, proof, draw and structured next question included. Credit prior scalar stabilizer, family-projector audit and PR589/555/1062 lineage.
